methodology.route_forecast: Route annual totals use a stabilized log-growth trend that blends recent and longer route history with the Tacurong ledger trend; route-specific growth is damped toward the city trend over the horizon. Month-by-month planning values then distribute each annual route total using the recurring Tacurong City electricity seasonality measured from WATTZAN 2020-2024 monthly profiles. The supplied route ledger itself is annual, so historical monthly route values shown in charts are explicitly seasonal reconstructions, not observed monthly route meter readings.
methodology.consumer_month_metric: Ledger Number of Consumers is accumulated across route ledger periods; kWh divided by those entries is displayed as a household-equivalent / consumer-month estimate, not a count of unique annual households.
methodology.route_map_geometry: OpenStreetMap provides the Tacurong basemap, road labels and landmarks. WATTZAN renders a shared street-aligned planning distribution network: major road corridors form grid trunks/feeders, route-path overlap strengthens shared corridors, and route-specific terminal branches remain clickable. The line hierarchy is a visualization/planning class, not measured voltage or verified SUKELCO conductor geometry, because the supplied route ledgers contain no official GIS conductor coordinates or voltage attributes. There is no verified conductor GIS geometry in the supplied files.
methodology.pre2020_consumption: 2016-2019 3D-map municipality values are bounded trend backcasts from the active WATTZAN 2020-2024 municipality series. 2025-2026 are clearly labeled planning trend forecasts from that same municipality-series lineage. The differently scaled SUKELCO Tacurong route ledger remains isolated in Route Intelligence.
methodology.weather_projection: 2020-2024 annual and monthly weather values come from the active WATTZAN municipality dataset. Future annual baselines retain the existing planning trends, while month-by-month projections add municipality-specific 2020-2024 climatological anomalies/shares so temperature, humidity, rainfall, heat index, wind and cloud cover retain recurring seasonal movement. These are planning projections, not deterministic long-range weather forecasts.
methodology.mlr_models: WATTZAN uses one pooled trained municipality-aware MLR pipeline. The 12 About-page equations are municipality-substituted forms/effective intercepts, not independently trained production MLR models.
methodology.long_term_seasonality: Long-term municipal electricity keeps the user-selected annual scenario trend and population adjustment, then allocates each projected annual total across months using the municipality-specific average monthly consumption profile from 2020-2024. Annual scenario totals are preserved exactly while monthly charts show recurring seasonal movement.
